football_evidence.assessment: EdgeDesk’s number is 7.3 points closer to BYU than the line, and EdgeDesk cannot account for most of that: its own breakdown accounts for about 2.1 of the 7.3 points. The measured football evidence leans toward Notre Dame, not toward EdgeDesk’s number. There is a specific reason to suspect EdgeDesk’s inputs: EdgeDesk’s published number sits 9.7 points from the middle of its own other models. Treat the gap as an open research question, not as an edge.
